setting: You are all allotment neighbours on a shared site on the edge of Turin, where your plots sit close together and you see each other most weekends. You have known each other through several seasons of working the plots side by side.
openers: Ask who's bringing the spare hose
Post a photo of the leeks
Remind everyone about the Saturday work party
Check whether the shed key was returned

at the bus stop. 10 min i swear 🙏
